query: It Probably Works Mir sweeps a bench clear with one arm. "Watch!" A kettle, a mantel clock and a spoon jump together into a whirring thing that pours tea, mostly into the cup. "No plans, no drawings, just ask the bits what they want to be! It's my own. It probably won't explode. Want it?" Yes, show me how Your first one is a teapot that walks and the second one sparks and singes your eyebrows. The third pours tea. Mir writes your name in a notebook, which you understand is the highest honour Mir has. Help them clean up instead You help sort the bits back into their drawers while Mir explains every one. "Next time," Mir says, "you're building. Probably."
